_note: Description-length rule only. A description shorter than min_chars cannot carry a mechanic, so the record binds weakly. The rule holds for every record unless one of `exceptions` appears in its template family or template id — a CONTAINS match, so a family can be named the way a person would say it. An exception that matches nothing fails preflight, so a typo cannot silently disable the rule. Empty exceptions means the rule holds universally.
